explanation:
Implement only the place stage from the acknowledged, unchanged frame-234 state. The prior placement attempt performed no actions: its corridor was clear and tilted pinch supported; only the later opening sweep was unknown. This revision audits the actual checkpoint shape, preserves the existing grasp and geometry, and does not repeat pickup or require release clearance before the separately supported closed-gripper route.

Reuse frame-matched successful depth measurements and the previously measured carton extent, opening and unchanged 3.5 mm fit requirement. Execute a measured raise, two short-edge tilt increments, elevated transfer, at most one centering correction, and a bounded above-lip descent. Reobserve the visible face and identified short end after each lease, comparing their motion to actual whole-lease hand motion. Bowl patterns can be replaced by distributed visible inner-lip measurements. One distinct measurement replacement is allowed per failed observation.

Only at the actual release endpoint assess the explicit lowering and finger-opening envelopes. The enlarged opening guard is a candidate empty-space region, not an invented measured stroke limit: a fresh review must support both containment of the visible mechanism's opening stroke and local clearance. Unknown remains a reason to withhold opening, not an obstruction to prior closed-gripper progress. Require fresh post-release containment depth, visible separation from both fingers and an unchanged upright bowl. No withdrawal or settled-verification control is included.
interface:
Executable Python main(api), using only np, math, geo, permitted builtins and the exact supplied API. Returns a JSON-compatible object with stage_status, reason, evidence, handoff and completion_proposed=false. Finite drive leases: raise at most 24 calls; two tilt leases at most 24 each; transfer at most 36; optional centering at most 12; descent at most 22. Each lease is additionally capped by remaining Jev/native budgets with an eight-call/24-step reserve. Opening uses at most four three-step controls and requires reserved effect-review budget. Control-slice boundaries do not cause yield.

Reuses place.geometry, place.progress, place.effect and place.revision without adding checkpoint keys. place.revision preserves the predecessor result and source provenance. place.geometry retains measured historical dimensions, original candidate tests and uncertainty, and records current geometry, rejected margins, explicit descent endpoint and opening guard. place.progress records pending commands, actual whole-lease poses, compact acknowledged receipts, differential retention tests, release state and terminal evidence. place.effect retains successful or partial raw depth reviews and measurement_errors. The handoff names these references, their frames and assumptions, rather than supplying later-stage code. Unexpected prior actions or a changed entry frame are audited and blocked rather than replayed.
jev_protocol:
All physical commands pass through real Jev in api.drive or api.control. Exactly seven control questions are supplied. Each of x,y,z,rx,ry,rz explicitly binds state.processed_features.axes.<axis>.goal_relation: increase means positive, decrease means negative, within_tolerance means hold. Signs refer to world translation coordinates or world rotation-vector components. The gripper question binds state.processed_features.objective.gripper: close continues the existing grasp command; open is requested only after release authorization; keep preserves the prior command. Answers are dispatched unchanged. Jev is not asked to observe images, calculate geometry, identify an object or certify retention.

Host residuals supply live pose feedback inside each lease. Program features supply the phase, source observation frame, measured carton/bowl uncertainty, required margin and release authorization. Whole-lease before/after robot states are recorded because drive's before/after describe only its last update. Reached is only pose/command convergence. A stalled or exhausted lease, command mismatch or invalid measurement stops with preserved progress rather than repeating a stalled action. Local loops and replacement observations are finite; the live stack continues across host control slices.

Geometry uses geo.plane, geo.circle_xy, geo.rotation, geo.transform and geo.attachment_error. Initial measurements are reused only while their frame matches the unchanged physical state, with membership, measurement_errors and plane quality checked. After motion, the same physical short-end corners are independently localized on a measured current printed face. Historical extent supplies only the previously measured rigid-box model. No opposite hidden corners or tracker are required. Relative feature spread constrains normal uncertainty; it is not a universal absolute object-size threshold. Missing depths or inadequate plane/correspondence evidence receive one different patch/camera measurement, with bowl marks replaceable by three distributed inner-lip samples.

Retention is supported by agreement of observed corner motion and face-normal change with the actual TCP rigid transform, never by closure or tracking alone. The preparation lift must produce predicted feature motion exceeding three times the attachment allowance. The allowance is 2 mm plus twice the combined measured boundary localization uncertainties; angular agreement includes both spread-dependent normal uncertainties. Fresh endpoint geometry, not an accumulated commanded transform, determines subsequent fit. Bowl-reference discrepancy above 2 mm requests new localization; accepted discrepancy increases opening uncertainty.

Position tolerance is 1.5 mm and rotation tolerance 0.015 rad; orientation error is included in carton extent uncertainty. The existing greater-than-3.5-mm lateral and transfer-clearance requirement is preserved. Sampled rotation envelopes include inter-sample and rotational stopping reserves. Descent targets 5.5 mm residual clearance after uncertainty and requires at least 3.5 mm actual residual clearance for the carton and proposed opening guard, with a drop to the observed floor no greater than 65 mm. The opening guard expands the measured closed finger box by its entire tool-y width on both sides plus 2 mm on every axis. This defines a candidate region to assess, not an assumed actuator limit. A fresh actual-pose review must independently support that the visible opening mechanism stays inside it and that its local sweep is clear; otherwise opening is withheld. Actual opening geometry and hand drift are checked after each bounded control. Opening saturation ends the loop rather than inviting blind repetitions.

Stage completion requires a fresh review showing the released carton inside the upright bowl, not rim-supported, with independent visible finger gaps, plus an actual carton depth point inside the uncertainty-eroded opening and below its uncertain lip. Opening delivery alone is insufficient. Evidence of loss, changed bowl configuration or an incorrect release requests replanning. Missing evidence returns blocked with the exact remaining gap. Only the outer supervisor can advance to withdrawal/settled verification or propose whole-task completion.
